relevant_laws.quote: Except for a motor vehicle, no person shall park any vehicle on any street for a period of time longer than thirty minutes between the hours of one a.m. and six a.m. of any day.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: source-gated nighttime street parking of a nonmotor carriage with another vehicle present
relevant_laws.notes: Carriage classification, parking activity, street and civil-time applicability require independent original sources.
